name: LIFE Privacy Evaluation — held-out linkability metrics

inputs.truth: oracle-only truth TSV; must never be passed to attack scoring code
inputs.scores: attack output with pair_id and score only
inputs.training_subjects: subject IDs available during attacker training/tuning; must be disjoint from test subjects

bootstrap.method: subject-cluster resampling with pair multiplicity weights
bootstrap.interval: percentile 95% interval; not a formal privacy guarantee

pilot_minimums.interpretation: necessary sample-size gates, not sufficient evidence or an automatic pass

source_contracts: scores TSV cannot contain labels or subject IDs
subject overlap between train and test fails closed
pair IDs are opaque and unique
comparison_policy: Run all required observer/scenario pairs where applicable; separately report each attacker and the strongest attacker result. Never treat an inapplicable channel as a privacy pass.
